B001304.name: Anthony Brown
B001304.bio: Democratic U.S. Representative for Maryland's 4th district from 2017 to 2023. He was Lieutenant Governor of Maryland and later became the state's Attorney General.

B001261.name: John Barrasso
B001261.bio: Republican U.S. Senator from Wyoming since 2007, first appointed to fill a vacancy. He is a physician from Casper.
